name: Meridian Weekend Tank — Racerback Cut
description: Slim racerback tank in deep teal with a slightly longer back hem, made from moisture-wicking synth-jersey. Simple, clean, no branding. The kind of item that appears in every tier because the cut is universally flattering and the price is reasonable enough to own in multiples.
functionality: Moisture-wicking fabric handles humid lake summers; racerback cut leaves chrome shoulder ports fully exposed.
what_it_says: You're practical, unassuming, and probably own four of these in different colors.
story_hooks: Velex's basics line is manufactured in a Tier 1 factory under contract — workers there recognize the label with complicated feelings.
The teal dye lot from this season is slightly off — collectors of a certain underground aesthetic are hunting the 'mistake' run.
